description: Foundation installation should avoid times when North Atlantic Right Whales (NARWs) are likely to occur in lease areas.
context_quote: Project schedules should avoid installing foundations during the time of year when NARWs are most likely to occur in the lease areas and along vessel routes.

description: Noise levels during construction must not exceed NOAA Fisheries' Level A permanent threshold shift limits for low frequency cetaceans at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation.
context_quote: Sound fields generated during impact pile driving should be reduced to the maximum extent practicable with a goal of not exceeding NOAA Fisheries’ Level A permanent threshold shift (PTS) limits for low frequency cetaceans (LFC) at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation.

description: Vessels must slow to 10 knots or less in areas where NARWs may be present.
geographic_scope: Areas where NARWs may be present
context_quote: All vessels should have a dedicated observer watching for NARWs at all times and slow to 10 knots or less at any time and/or location that NARWs may be present.

description: Clearance zones must be established around sound sources to monitor for NARWs before starting activities.
context_quote: A clearance zone is an area around a sound source, monitored by PSOs, wherein a detection of a NARW triggers a delay in turning on the sound source.

description: Shutdown zones must be established around sound sources to stop activities if NARWs are detected.
context_quote: A shutdown zone is an area around a sound source, monitored by PSOs, wherein a detection of a NARW triggers a stop of the activity.
